name: W1.5: AI Social Media Post Refiner (Vision, Brand, Agents, Mail)

parameters.jsCode:
const input = $input.first().json.body || $input.first().json;

const state = {
  userId: input.userId || input.user_id || "",
  userEmail: input.userEmail || input.user_email || "",
  brand_name: input.brand_name || "",
  
  content: input.content || {},
  title: input.title || {},
  tags: input.tags || [],
  image_url: input.image_url || "",
  platforms: input.platforms || [],
  
  platforms_to_edit: Array.isArray(input.platforms_to_edit) ? input.platforms_to_edit : [],
  human_preference: input.human_preference || "",
  image_preference: input.image_preference || "no_change",
  previous_image_prompt: input.image_prompt_current || {},
  image_prompt_current: input.image_prompt_current || {},
  vision_analysis: "",
  
  text_retries_left: 3,
  text_approved: false,
  text_critique: "",
  
  image_retries_left: 3,
  image_approved: false,
  image_critique: ""
};

return [{ json: state }];

options.systemMessage:
You are an elite social media content editor.
1. ONLY modify platforms listed in 'Platforms to Edit'.
2. For platforms NOT in the edit list, return their exact original text.
3. Apply the 'Human Feedback' surgically.
4. Adopt the Brand Style provided.

Return ONLY valid JSON:
{
  "linkedin": "",
  "facebook": "",
  "twitter": "",
  "instagram": "",
  "reddit": ""
}
